title: Concurrent audit appends from several processes lose no SAFE-5 rows: regression test for REQ-plugins-287 multi-process acceptance (review follow-up for PR 211)
description: Concurrent audit appends from several processes lose no SAFE-5 rows: regression test for REQ-plugins-287 multi-process acceptance (review follow-up for PR 211)
acceptance_criteria: Four bun processes each open the shared file DB, append one SAFE-5 audit row and close it, 40 times each, at the same time; every append succeeds, the audit_log holds all 160 rows and verifyAudit reports the chain ok. The same test loses rows (database is locked) on the pre-fix deferred transaction.
